prompt: Our retry helper gives up one attempt too early and waits the wrong amount of time between tries. The retry loop lives in src/retry.mjs (it calls the function until it succeeds or the max-attempts budget is spent) and the delay schedule lives in src/backoff.mjs (it returns how long to wait before the next try). Fix both so the loop uses the full max-attempts budget and the backoff delays start at the base delay and double from there. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the fix and pass after the fix.
